content: Let P be a plane containing the line $${{x - 1} \over 3} = {{y + 6} \over 4} = {{z + 5} \over 2}$$ and parallel to the line $${{x - 1} \over 4} = {{y - 2} \over { - 3}} = {{z + 5} \over 7}$$. If the point (1, $$-$$1, $$\alpha$$) lies on the plane P, then the value of |5$$\alpha$$| is equal to ____________.
